text:
Rena Li: Heads-up from testing the new dashboard preview: the floating toast sits on top of the table actions and clips the ghost button focus. Also noticed modal footer shadow weight feels inconsistent with card shadows. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/preview-toast-clip.png :camera:

Omar G.: Repro on Chromium. Toast is still appended inside .dashboard-list which creates a new stacking context. We should portal it to root and make it fixed-top.

design-bot: Recommendation summary: 1) Add token `--toast-position: fixed-top` and `--toast-offset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-3))`. 2) Introduce `--shadow-modal-footer-sm: 0 3px 10px rgba(2,6,23,0.06)` to match card elevation. 3) Increase primary ghost focus to 2px on `surface-dark`.

Tess (a11y): Strong +1 for explicit SR copy. Avoid bare "Saved". Prefer templates so product can pass `"{entity} saved"` or fallback to "Changes saved". Also ensure toasts use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` and include context for multi-panel consoles.

Ben Morales: For z-index, lowering toast to 1100 feels safest so dropdowns (1250) still float above. Alternatively bump menus to 1300 but that feels noisy. I vote lowering toast and adding `pointer-events: none` to the wrapper so toasts don't block underlying taps.

Rena Li: Can we make tokens opt-in? Some teams rely on inline toasts in embedded views. Suggest `--legacy-toast-inline: false` and `--toast-mode: token|legacy` with clear migration note.

Omar G.: I'll open a tiny PR on `ui/fixes` with: portal + fixed top anchor, toast z-index 1100, token defs, and a visual snapshot for dense table+toast. Will include a migration note in components docs. ETA EOD. :thumbsup: 

Tess (a11y): Please add an automated storybook axe check and a small Jest snapshot that asserts aria-live + role present and that the message includes fallback text when entity is absent.

Ben Morales: Also adjust modal-footer shadow token and update docs examples. Keep old token name as alias for backward compat: `--elevation-modal-footer-legacy` -> `--shadow-modal-footer-sm`.

Rena Li: Thanks! If PR is green let's ship in the next patch. Quick copy change approved: use "{entity} saved" with fallback "Changes saved". I'll update the design tokens doc and call out the focus change on dark surfaces.

Omar G.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/901 - includes tokens, portal change, tests. Requesting reviews from Tess and Rena.

Tess (a11y): Reviewing now. Will re-run axe checks and report back.
